notes.text: Achan --called afterwards "Achar" ("trouble") (1Ch 2:7). Achan =" troubler" 1) a Judaite who violated God’s specific ban on taking any loot from the captured city of Jericho and was stoned to death along with his family for this violation
Carmi =" my vineyard" 1) the 4th son of Reuben and progenitor of the Carmites 2) a Judaite, father of Achan, the ‘troubler of Israel’ in the time of Joshua

quotes.text: Zerah --or Zarah, son of Judah and Tamar (Ge 38:30). His genealogy is given probably to show that from a parentage so infamous the descendants would not be carefully trained in the fear of God.
quotes.speaker: Robert Jamieson
